name: ai-residue-cleaner
description: AI 残渣清运(AI Residue Cleaner):把 AI 会话留下的草稿、备份、日志、缓存收进可逆回收站,带清单可还原;项目结项时归类成品、归档可引用结果、生成结项清理清单,未结项期间一切保留。 (ZCode plugin + DeepSeek Harness bundle)

description_i18n.zh-CN: AI 残渣清运(AI Residue Cleaner):把 AI 会话留下的草稿、备份、日志、缓存收进可逆回收站,带清单可还原;项目结项时归类成品、归档可引用结果、生成结项清理清单,未结项期间一切保留。
description_i18n.en: Sweeps AI byproducts into a reversible per-project trash with manifests; project mode keeps byproducts until close, then classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report.
